title: Weed phase result
description: The typed record the weed phase returns to the loop orchestrator in place of a prose summary. The structured fields drive deterministic routing and convergence; `summary` carries the one human-readable line so nothing is lost.

verdict.description: clean = spec and code agree; dirty = at least one divergence remains

divergences.description: every unresolved divergence; empty when verdict is clean

subject.description: the entity, rule or trigger the divergence is about

spec.description: what the spec says, with file:line where known

code.description: what the code does, with file:line where known

open_questions.description: questions parked for a human; each also recorded as an `open question` in the spec when weed writes one

artefacts.description: spec files edited, in update-spec / update-code modes
